transcript.text: Hi, the light in my Neff oven has stopped working (model B1ACE4HN0B). Oven works fine otherwise. Can I change the bulb myself and what bulb do I need?

Yes, you can replace the bulb yourself as long as the oven is completely cool and switched off at the mains. For your Neff B1ACE4HN0B, you typically need a 25W heat-resistant appliance bulb with an SES (small Edison screw) cap that is rated for temperatures up to 300°C or higher. These are often sold as 'oven bulbs' in hardware stores; if you cannot find one locally, checking the Neff parts website or a reputable appliance spares supplier using your model number will give you the exact specification. Once installed, ensure it is screwed in firmly but do not overtighten.

plan: They asked: "Can I change the bulb myself and what bulb do I need?" - answer that first.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make Neff; model B1ACE4HN0B.
The fault they reported is: "light has stopped working". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
